source: same registered GIST FP32 and phase-B fixed short events
snapshots: occurrence list after first true rebuild
queries: first 32 frozen workflow query coordinates mapped by original row onto the initial snapshot, and first 32 after first rebuild onto the rebuilt snapshot; convert query kind only to kNN, B1 K8; verify original physical lineage byte-for-byte
modes: native Faiss 1.15.1 GpuIndexFlatL2 FP32 no cuVS
order: initial FULL/BOUND/FLAT then rebuilt FULL/BOUND/FLAT, each one fresh process
GTS_warmup: qualified independent clone, 19 events/8 queries/one actual rebuild; release and restore snapshot
Flat_warmup: eight fixed snapshot queries; static index is not updated
scope: static 32-query Host-ready service pass plus final service-device release; setup/warmup separately recorded; no update/refit/repack cost, no dynamic external end-to-end claim
query_ack_sum: GTS nested operation timing sum only, not another continuous e2e denominator
reference: independent CPU ordered FP64 full scan; legal same-distance boundary ties accepted for external memberships; internal exact ordered ID and FP32 field identity
external_field_tolerance: absolute squared distance error/max(reference squared,1) <= 5e-5 inherited from native adapter; preserve raw native squared fields and every mismatch
isolation: same caller-selected idle GPU and live-verified NUMA placement through unchanged existing advisory GPU guard; no device settings or foreign processes touched
optional_IVF_ALL: not included in this six-process admission; an additional two diagnostic processes only if separately registered
